subject.title: fix(ui): create named Control UI chat sessions

question: Should Control UI intentionally treat every `/new <text>` argument as a new session label, with model switching moved to `/model`, while other chat surfaces retain `/new <model>` semantics?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and documented, but it creates an intentional user-facing grammar split and overlaps a separate shared-command proposal; code review cannot choose that permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve Control UI-specific naming
options.body: Accept `/new <text>` as a Control UI label shortcut, keep `/name <title>` for renaming, and close the overlapping named-new portion of the broader command proposal after this lands.

options.title: Require explicit named-new syntax
options.body: Preserve `/new <model>` expectations and require an unambiguous syntax such as `/new --name <title>` or another owner-approved action.

options.title: Use one shared command grammar
options.body: Pause this PR and consolidate named-session creation across chat surfaces with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95700.

recommendation.title: Approve Control UI-specific naming
recommendation.body: Accept `/new <text>` as a Control UI label shortcut, keep `/name <title>` for renaming, and close the overlapping named-new portion of the broader command proposal after this lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main area contributor across the affected Control UI and session lifecycle paths and were directly asked for this product/UX decision.
